responsibility: This file implements an RTL optimization pass that detects harmful store-to-load forwarding patterns within a basic block and rewrites them to avoid microarchitectural store-forwarding stalls. It scans simple loads and stores, uses alias/dependence checks and memory-size/offset analysis to recognize cases where smaller stores feed a larger later load from the same base address, then either eliminates the load when stores fully cover it or moves the stores after the load while synthesizing bit-insert repair sequences so the loaded register still reflects the stored bytes. It owns the pass registration, candidate tracking, legality/profitability checks, and transformation/statistics logic for `-favoid-store-forwarding`.
same_name_distinction: Implements the avoid-store-forwarding pass itself: the RTL scan, legality/profitability analysis, transformations, statistics, and pass entrypoint. In this same-name pair, the .h only defines the internal `store_fwd_info` bookkeeping record used by this implementation.
